import re

def compare_versions(a, b):
    # Regular expression to validate version strings
    version_pattern = r'^(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)$'
    
    # Validate version strings
    if not re.match(version_pattern, a) or not re.match(version_pattern, b):
        raise ValueError("Invalid version string format")
    
    # Split version strings into components
    a_parts = list(map(int, a.split('.')))
    b_parts = list(map(int, b.split('.')))
    
    # Compare each component numerically
    for i in range(3):
        if a_parts[i] < b_parts[i]:
            return -1
        elif a_parts[i] > b_parts[i]:
            return 1
    
    # If all components are equal
    return 0

import unittest
from minstack import MinStack

class TestMinStack(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_push(self):
        stack = MinStack()
        stack.push(3)
        self.assertEqual(stack.get_min(), 3)
        stack.push(5)
        self.assertEqual(stack.get_min(), 3)
        stack.push(2)
        self.assertEqual(stack.get_min(), 2)
        stack.push(1)
        self.assertEqual(stack.get_min(), 1)

    def test_pop(self):
        stack = MinStack()
        stack.push(3)
        stack.push(5)
        stack.push(2)
        stack.push(1)
        self.assertEqual(stack.pop(), 1)
        self.assertEqual(stack.get_min(), 2)
        self.assertEqual(stack.pop(), 2)
        self.assertEqual(stack.get_min(), 3)
        self.assertEqual(stack.pop(), 5)
        self.assertEqual(stack.get_min(), 3)
        self.assertEqual(stack.pop(), 3)
        with self.assertRaises(IndexError):
            stack.pop()

    def test_top(self):
        stack = MinStack()
        stack.push(3)
        stack.push(5)
        stack.push(2)
        stack.push(1)
        self.assertEqual(stack.top(), 1)
        with self.assertRaises(IndexError):
            MinStack().top()

    def test_get_min(self):
        stack = MinStack()
        stack.push(3)
        stack.push(5)
        stack.push(2)
        stack.push(1)
        self.assertEqual(stack.get_min(), 1)
        with self.assertRaises(IndexError):
            MinStack().get_min()

    unittest.main()
